Dear Hadia,

Happy 24th Birthday.

You are not only my elder sister, but one of the greatest blessings Allah has given me.

Thank you for always caring for me, supporting me, encouraging me and standing beside me.

I pray that Allah blesses you with endless happiness, good health, success, peace and barakah.

May every dream of yours come true. May your smile never fade.

I will always be grateful to have a sister like you. Happy Birthday once again.

With endless love, Your Little Brother, Hussnain ❤️
🌹

نہیں ہے رشتہ خون کا، مگر دل سے قریب ہے

جو بہن کبھی نہ ملی مجھے، وہ تُو نصیب ہے

نہ مانگی تھی دعا میں کبھی، پھر بھی مل گئی

اے میری آپا، تیری محبت ہی میرا نصیب ہے

Nahi hai rishta khoon ka, magar dil se qareeb hai

Jo behen kabhi na mili mujhe, wo tu naseeb hai

Na maangi thi dua mein kabhi, phir bhi mil gayi

Aye meri Api, teri mohabbat hi mera naseeb hai
